description: Large vertical canvas with a dominant blue form that flows from the upper left to the middle of the bottom in a ground of white and grey.  Branching off from the thick blue shape is a thin blue line that makes a V through the white on the right side of the canvas.
imageCaption: Courtesy of Georgia O'Keeffe Museum. Photo: Tim Nighswander/IMAGING4ART
